name: Galileo (GNSS)
agency: ESA / EU Agency for the Space Programme (EUSPA)
best_known_for: Europe's civilian GNSS — ~30 satellites at 23,222 km MEO / 56° inclination / 3 planes; 34 launched, 27 operational + 1 commissioning; designed for sub-metre positioning
credit: ESA / EUSPA Galileo programme. Civilian-managed (unlike GPS / GLONASS military operators); open + commercial + Public Regulated Service tiers.
